entry.title: Log4Shell: A Large-Scale Analysis of the Vulnerability & Its Exploitation
entry.summary: The Log4Shell vulnerability (CVE-2021-44228) in Apache Log4j2 allows remote code execution through attacker controlled JNDI lookups. We analyze exploitation traffic and mitigation at Internet scale.

entry.title: Deserialization Vulnerabilities in Java: A Survey of Mitigations
entry.summary: We survey code injection and unsafe deserialization flaws in Java applications, comparing static analysis and sandboxing mitigations for unsafe lookup endpoints such as LDAP during runtime execution and code loading.
